main_text.head: CHARACTE-RUM IESUITI-CORUM
CENTURIA TERTIA.
main_text.p: SCRIPTVRAS, quæ multifariam ac multis modis intelliguntur, simpliciter considerantes [idest, ad unicum & proprium sui ingenii sensum accommodantes] excidunt, cum bene ducinon patiantur. Et quod mirum est, Scripturæ quæ iuvant eos qui per fidem valet, officiunt istis qui circa quæstiones ac inutiles contentiones ægrotant. Item: Quærunt non ut fidem, sed ut infidelitatem inveniât. Basilius Magnus, lib. 5. contra Eunomium.

Curiosa istorum hominum circa syllabas ac dictiones observatio, haudquaquam simplex alicui videri possit, neq; ad mediocre tendens malum: sed profundum atq; obtectum habet adversus pietatem consilium. Idem, de Sp. S. ad Amphiloch. cap. 1.

Quoniam Sophisticen didicerunt, & ut præ-clara mirantur quæ didicerunt, observationes ex frustranea Philosophia,eque inani deceptio-ne sumptas ad simplicem artificii ignaram do-ctrinam transferunt: cap. 3.

page.notes: Title is set in capitals with hyphens at the line ends. Long s in "istorum" and "Sophisticen" read as plain s. "5" after "lib." is doubtful [?] in the scan, though it reads as 5. "ducinon" is printed without a space and is left as printed. Abbreviations neq; and atq; are kept as printed.
